source.originalTitle: The horse has a few questions.
source.scope: Source-bounded reconstruction of the two short encounter paragraphs. The two journey compositions and introductions are new Usewords authored material.

values.J.subject: place.water
values.J.title: The horse has a few questions.
J.paragraphs: The guide points at the water. The horse looks down. There is already a horse in there, and it seems to have strong opinions about the guide. Nobody mentioned a committee.

Perhaps the next explanation can wait. What is the horse being invited into? The guide can look at the reflection too. You can read the little fable your own way—or just enjoy a horse declining a well-prepared presentation.
values.J.introduction: Start by noticing what the other person is encountering, before offering your explanation.
